# Enterprise SaaS Platform Overview

## Overview
This dashboard provides a unified view of platform health, workforce activity, and cross-module engagement across the workspace. It is designed for platform administrators and operations leads who need real-time visibility into module adoption, team performance, and support ticket volume.

## Key Metrics
- Active Headcount: 1,240
- Open Support Tickets: 84
- On-Time Project Delivery: 87%
- SLA Compliance: 94.2%

## Insights
- Cross-module adoption has grown 8% quarter-over-quarter, driven by HR Hub and Projects integration
- Support ticket volume is within normal range; Module Setup tickets represent 30% of total volume
- Project delivery rate is above the 85% threshold for the current quarter
